svg.title: Domain Model - Buffet Restaurant Management System (implemented V19 menu-stock extension)

g.text: Domain Model - Buffet Restaurant Management System (implemented V19 menu-stock extension)
Conceptual domain relationships are not reverse JPA collections.
Session owns table/package/soup FK associations; Grant owns session_id.
Opening-price snapshot stays internal to the Billing reader.
PAID and COMPLETED are separate; bill request keeps the session ACTIVE.
openingTargetStock / active implemented in Flyway V15.
shortfall is derived from target - quantity and is not persisted.
No stock reservation. Consumption at RECEIVED to PREPARING.
Recipe edits affect future orders only; old orders without snapshots stay untracked.
